review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — init.ts adds history.jsonl to the ignoreInRivetari list. The new test and the updated exact-content assertion in init.test.ts both check it.
- A2: met — The new test runs git init and rivetari init, writes .rivetari/history.jsonl, then checks it is missing from git status --untracked-files=all and that git check-ignore succeeds.
- A3: met — The only change to init.test.ts is the expected .gitignore string at line 123, which gains history.jsonl\n. The card explicitly allows this change to a protected path.

<details><summary>3 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- A2 test also asserts profile.yml shows as untracked, which A2 doesn't need `packages/cli/src/commands/init-history-ignore.test.ts:67` — Drop the profile.yml assertion, or assert that some .rivetari/ entry appears in status without naming a particular file.
- history.jsonl is written by hand rather than through close's writer `packages/cli/src/commands/init-history-ignore.test.ts:54` — Take the path from the constant or helper close uses, if one is exported.
- Comment above the ignore list only mentions backups `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts:585` — Reword it to cover local runtime output and backups, which are for the person and not for commits.

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: A2 test also asserts profile.yml shows as untracked, which A2 doesn't need
suggestions.detail: The last assertion ties this test to other init outputs: that init writes .rivetari/profile.yml and that runInit doesn't commit or ignore it. A later change to either would fail a test about history.jsonl for an unrelated reason. Its apparent purpose is to show that git status ran and saw .rivetari/, and the check-ignore assertion already covers that.
suggestions.repro: Change init so it commits its scaffold or stops writing profile.yml; this test fails even though history.jsonl is still ignored.
suggestions.fix: Drop the profile.yml assertion, or assert that some .rivetari/ entry appears in status without naming a particular file.

suggestions.title: history.jsonl is written by hand rather than through close's writer
suggestions.detail: The test writes the file to a hard-coded path. If close ever moves where it writes history, this test keeps passing while the real file shows up in git status again.
suggestions.repro: Change close to write history to .rivetari/metrics/history.jsonl; this test still passes, but the new file is untracked.
suggestions.fix: Take the path from the constant or helper close uses, if one is exported.

suggestions.title: Comment above the ignore list only mentions backups
suggestions.detail: The comment says the list is backups. The list also holds local runtime output (tasks/, ai-usage.log, cache/ and now history.jsonl), so the comment is further from what the list does.
suggestions.repro: Read init.ts:585 next to the list it describes.
suggestions.fix: Reword it to cover local runtime output and backups, which are for the person and not for commits.
